observed_failure.interpretation: The memory writer recovers the behavior, but the byte decoder does not reliably consume the rule-memory token.

root_cause_hypothesis.claim: A high-confidence executable memory should be authoritative for its covered query; treating it as ordinary byte text loses the result.

minimal_change.name: confidence-gated executable Rule Memory head
minimal_change.gate: Use the context-derived prediction only when context agreement is at least 0.75; otherwise defer to neural logits.

decision: Evaluate the same checkpoint with and without the gate. If the gate clears the first-seed family thresholds, train and evaluate seeds 20260817 and 20260903 under the frozen iteration-06 design.
